evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Commissive act ratifying an operational cadence ('run monthly from now on') and crystallizing it into a constitutive rule — the second sentence performs the settling by equating unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all. Decision-grade: the speaker commits the org to act and frames the rule as load-bearing, not merely argued for.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here settling an operational rule by equating unrehearsed capability with absence of capability?
